Adjust BB for network work sf object

Source: R/add_convert_bb_adj.R
add_convert_bb_adj.Rd

Adjust BB for network work sf object

Usage

add_convert_bb_adj(network_sf, asp = 1)

Arguments

network_sf

network sf objects

asp

aspect ratio

Value

same network sf with adjusted aspect ration

Examples

add_convert_bb_adj(example_sf)
